scope: Spot current-open-orders baseline, exact financial display/filter counts and typed Spot execution-report reconciliation. Separate from Perp orders and Spot order history; read-only increment.

prd.requirement: Query current Spot orders, count under the same filter scope; a single-symbol count cannot be presented as all-account count. Public API alternative: GET /api/v3/openOrders.
prd.revalidated: Notion fetch this increment; page verification state unverified. Requirement evidence is explicit table text, not screenshot inference.

official_source.refresh: Anonymous raw GitHub read this increment; no exchange account request.

endpoint.symbol: Optional in official API. App deliberately omits symbol on explicit user read to obtain full Spot baseline; no inherited Perp current symbol, no automatic polling.
endpoint.authentication: V3 EIP-712 AsterSignTransaction v1, chain1666, exact nonce/user/signer query signed, signature appended last. Shared monotonic microsecond nonce. Current connected EOA or existing email wallet signs; no additional wallet. Actual API authorization remains unverified.
endpoint.metadata: Anonymous GET /api/v3/exchangeInfo for exact Spot baseAsset/quoteAsset only after nonempty signed snapshot. Public metadata failures retain orders and show unknown units; no symbol suffix parsing or Perp metadata fallback.
endpoint.response: Array of current active Spot orders; bounded10000 rows, strict exact string money/IDs/status/side/timestamps. Identical duplicates collapse, conflicting same-symbol/ID duplicates reject. Terminal/unrecognized status in purported active snapshot fails closed rather than inventing an empty list.

presentation.entry: Spot account panel → Spot open orders. Opening screen does not sign or fetch private data. Signed-out read opens existing authentication; restored EOA reconnects same wallet.
fields: Quote-sized market original quote amount with base total/remaining unknown
Limit/average/trigger prices and cumulative quote amount
presentation.financial_policy: Decimal throughout; no double money and no guessed average from incomplete data. Event O missing/zero remains unknown, never replaced with T/E. Missing units remain unknown. Quote-sized MARKET with zero base origQty does not acquire a fabricated base total.
presentation.filters: Local case-insensitive symbol/orderId/clientOrderId search; displayed count uses exactly displayed rows, clear/empty/no-match independent states. Filter survives refresh/failure; clears on wallet identity change. No network query or wallet signature when filtering.
presentation.states: Initial/no baseline, explicit loading/stop, complete-empty, nonempty, missing units, stale/partial event, safe retryable failure with retained rows. Thirty-second stale timer does not auto sign/read. English/Chinese catalogs and responsive ListView/safe-area/keyboard support.
presentation.boundaries: No Perp positionSide, leverage, reduceOnly, margin or Long/Short derived for Spot. This increment adds no Spot order creation, cancellation or account mutation and does not substitute trade history for current orders.

events.path: Existing separately authorized Spot /api/v3/listenKey → wss://sstream.asterdex.com/ws/<key>; no automatic new signature on screen entry. Reuse current in-memory lease and existing wallet/lifecycle handling.
events.transport: Spot executionReport validated by existing Spot notification mapper, additionally mapped to SpotOpenOrderUpdate including f(timeInForce). Same event can feed notification inbox and Spot open orders; never enters Perp reconciliation.
events.baseline_required: Events alone never prove a complete account list or establish an empty baseline. Only apply events received during a REST read plus applicable newer row updates and terminal tombstones.
events.ordering: Symbol+orderId keys, event E and transaction T ordering, nondecreasing filled quantity, duplicate suppression and permanent terminal tombstones for scope. Compare server updateTime with T, not local receive time. Prior active events absent from a new full snapshot cannot resurrect rows.
events.failure: Disconnect/reconnect/expiry/pause/configuration/unknown events mark snapshot stale. Missing-event gap requires another explicit complete signed read. Local controller preserves prior snapshot on failure; scope reset clears private data and event book.
events.capacity: 10000 per-wallet in-memory event keys; never silently evict financial tombstones. Capacity failure terminates live processing with safe localized failure; explicit signed reads still inspect baseline. Scope change resets book. Not a persisted event history or full missed-event replay.

verification_boundary: Only unit/Widget substitutes, mock HTTP/signers and existing loopback WebSocket harness. No device tools, APK install, live wallet/RPC/private/financial request. Android release build is not native acceptance; iOS unavailable on Linux.
remaining: Real EOA/Privy signer eligibility, full Spot account response scope and real order lifecycle remain unverified.
Native wallet round-trips, layouts, reconnect/background and iOS are recorded in native-verification-pending.md.
